title: Total Energy Radiated
description: Essential Criteria: The total rate of energy radiated from the disk must be correctly calculated as 3.14 W.

title: Magnification Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the magnification and relate object and image distances using the lens equation.

title: Energy Flux Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The total energy flux reaching the 0.25 cm^2 disk must be estimated correctly as approximately 8.7 x 10^-4 W.

title: Maximum Energy Flux Reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning behind the maximum energy flux into the disk must reference the second law of thermodynamics.

title: Solid Angle Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The calculation of the solid angle subtended by the lens at the source should be included for completeness.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in calculations or incorrect assumptions about the lens should be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations to avoid unit mistakes.
